editor_process_ownership_scope: Original driver required exact title/image and a single matching editor, then normal close waited for the launched process. It did not persist or explicitly assert HWND PID == Popen PID; the public runner now requires this guard.
published_runner_review: The public QA drivers additionally enforce HWND PID == Popen PID, assert hotkey_active after readiness polling and assert the resulting seek time. These stronger guards do not retroactively expand the original portable receipt.
